description: This file is a C++ source file implementing a service for Android's Keymint remote key management. It sets up and registers multiple remote key management services, initializes communication channels with the hardware, and handles security level retrieval.

classes.name: RemoteKeyMintDevice
classes.description: A class representing the remote key mint device service.

classes.name: RemoteSecureClock
classes.description: A class representing the remote secure clock service.

classes.name: RemoteSharedSecret
classes.description: A class representing the remote shared secret service.

classes.name: RemoteRemotelyProvisionedComponent
classes.description: A class representing the remotely provisioned component service.

methods.name: addService
methods.description: Template function to create and register a service instance with the Android service manager.

methods.name: getSecurityLevel
methods.description: Retrieves the security level from a remote keymaster by requesting a timestamp token.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that initializes logging, sets up communication channels, initializes remote keymaster, registers services, and joins the thread pool.
